sentences.text: The challenge in this petition is made to the FIR No. 1698 of 2022 dated 30.12.2022, under Section 376(2)(n), 420 and 506 of IPC, registered at Police Station Manglaur, District Haridwar.

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: According to FIR, the petitioner and the informant met on 26.08.2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The petitioner assured the informant of a job and demanded Rs. 35,000/-.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The informant paid this amount.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text:
According to FIR,
the informant was not offered any job, instead the petitioner repeatedly raped the informant on multiple occasions at various places.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner and the informant both have entered into a compromise.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The informant has accepted that at the behest of some villagers, she lodged the FIR.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: She has also accepted that she received Rs.35,000/- from the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. It is a petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: In case, FIR discloses commission of offences, generally no interference is warranted.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The FIR in the instant case, reveals serious offences of rape etc.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: In such cases, compromise cannot be a ground to quash an F.I.R.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 20 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: The question perhaps that would require to be answered during investigation is as to whether the petitioner tried to tamper with the evidence and have approached the informant with some motives.

sentences.text: The present writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, whereby petitioner has put to challenge F.I.R. No.0091 of 2025 dated 04.03.2025, under Section 420 of IPC registered at Police Station Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, on the ground that parties have entered into an amicable settlement and they want to put this matter to rest.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 8 May, 2025.json

sentences.text: 2. A joint compounding application has been moved on behalf of the parties seeking to compound offences under the aforesaid section.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 8 May, 2025.json

sentences.text: 3. Petitioner as well as respondent no.3 are present before this Court, who are duly identified by their respective counsel.
sentences._hearing_file: Unknown vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 8 May, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4. The ground for seeking compounding of offences is that parties have reached to the terms of compromise wherefor a settlement has also reached between them.

sentences.text: It is thus, prayed that the present proceedings between the parties may be quashed in terms of the compromise arrived at between the parties.

2. A joint compounding application has been moved on behalf of the parties seeking to compound offences under the aforesaid section.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
It is thus, prayed that the present proceedings between the parties may be quashed in terms of the compromise arrived at between the parties.
7. Compounding Application (IA No.1 of 2025) is allowed.
